name: Lord Pythas
summary: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Lord Pythas guards Naralex's slumber. Once a night elf warrior in Naralex's personal guard, he now leads the corrupted Druids of the Fang. His skill in battle and serpent magic bar the way to his master.

sections.title: A Guardian Falls
sections.body: Pythas joined Naralex's personal guard when the druid's expedition entered the Barrens' dry wastes. A seasoned night elf warrior, he studied druidism to help Naralex restore life to the arid realm. Yet discipline and valor could not shield him from the corruption hidden in the caverns' depths.

sections.title: The Lethal Sentinel
sections.body:
Dark nightmares seized Naralex's connection to the Emerald Dream. Pythas and his fellow acolytes fell under their sway. He forsook his old loyalty and became a leader of the Druids of the Fang.

Some serpent lords favor spells or beast forms. Pythas wields nature magic alongside deadly combat skill. Now he prowls the winding caverns and guards the nightmare's hold on the spring.

faq.answer: Lord Pythas once served in Naralex's personal guard and studied druidism to aid his master's work in the Barrens. He was a night elf warrior.

faq.q: Why did he turn against Naralex?
aliases: why did he become druid of the fang
faq.answer: Pythas turned against Naralex after a nightmare seized the archdruid's thoughts as he reached into the Emerald Dream to heal the Barrens. Corruption spread through Naralex's acolytes, stripping Pythas of his sanity and remaking him as a serpent lord.

faq.q: What makes Pythas different from the other Fang leaders?
faq.answer: Pythas was a seasoned warrior before training as a druid, and he joins martial skill with nature magic. The other Fang leaders rely on nature magic and beast forms.

faq.q: Why do adventurers need to defeat him?
faq.answer: Pythas guards one of four enchanted gems needed to free the Barrens from the Fang leaders' twisted dreams. Nara Wildmane, a druid in Thunder Bluff, seeks all four gems.

faq.q: Where can Lord Pythas be found?
faq.answer: Lord Pythas lurks in the deep chambers of the Wailing Caverns, among corrupted beasts and fellow Fang cultists.

After Pythas is defeated, the Gem of Pythas can be recovered from his remains. The four serpent lords' gems are brought to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff as proof that the Fang's leadership has been broken.

angles.text: As a druid, Pythas shows how corruption in the Emerald Dream can twist devotion to nature magic.
As a warrior, remember that Pythas was a disciplined night elf fighter and personal protector before corruption took hold. Martial skill alone could not guard his mind.
As a night elf seeking to restore balance to Kalimdor's scarred soils, Pythas's fall to madness is a bitter sorrow.
